name: De Gooyer
description: De Gooyer is the Netherlands’ tallest wooden windmill. Its octagonal grain mill was built around 1725 and moved here in 1814 after a barracks obstructed its wind. It stands on the raised square brick base of a former city water mill. The gallery is 17.8 metres above ground and the sails span 26.6 metres. Brouwerij ’t IJ occupies the separate former bathhouse next door.
